clos.description: Describe the key principles of process safety and maintenance of industrial operations.
Explain the practical application of safety and risk management in process industry.
Explain the fundamentals of polymer engineering: classification, rheology, colligative, thermal, and mechanical properties.
Relate fundamental concepts of polymer engineering to study techniques for synthesis and processing of polymeric materials.
Comprehend the process of transforming resources into products and development of its operational strategy.
Use a variety of problem-solving and forecasting techniques to aid in effective decision making and quality control.
Apply project management tools, techniques and inventory management methods.
Infer the basic knowledge about gas processing and gas drilling.
Comprehend the understanding of gas storage and transmission operations.
Analyze and design gas processing and purification operations.
Comprehend the fundamental theories of sociology pertaining to human behaviors.
Devise the practical applications of the theories to human behavior in day-to-day life.

courses.title: Data Science & ML in Chemical Engineering

clos.description: Describe and apply the concepts of linear algebra, probability, and statistics used for data distributions.
Use mathematical and statistical theory for decision-making and problem solution.
Apply algorithms of data science and machine learning using Python.
Comprehend the concepts of Engineering Economics.
Gain working knowledge of money management and analyse economics comparisons of alternative engineering projects.
Apply alternatives based on taxable income and market structure.
Comprehend the principles of simultaneous heat and mass transfer and extend their applications in chemical engineering processes.
Describe the coupled heat and mass transfer equations and apply to design the process equipment.
Solve and analyze complex engineering problems pertaining to SHMT operation.
Measures key process variables such as temperature, flow rate, and composition during separation process equipment operation.
Compute and analyze performance metrics (drying rate, extraction efficiency) from collected experimental data.
Participate actively and responsibly in teamwork while conducting separation experiments and handling equipment.
Adjust and operate experimental units such as evaporators, dryers, and extraction columns under supervision.
Comprehend open/closed loop control systems based on the fundamentals of process dynamics.
Solve problems related to open/closed control loop systems.
Design and explain control loops for process variables (temperature, pressure, level, etc.) of a given industrial process.
Calibrate automatic process control sensors (flow, pressure, temperature, level) using manual instruments as reference standards.
Follow procedures to apply ON/OFF, PI, and PID control modes for achieving set points and accurately adjust input parameters.
Analyze and interpret process response curves in relation to control theory to evaluate performance of control strategies.
Demonstrate responsible handling of control equipment and participate effectively in group-based experimentation and troubleshooting.
Comprehend the concepts of reaction engineering fundamentals.
Apply design equations of ideal reactors to study their performance for homogenous single and multiple reactions.
Differentiate homogeneous and heterogeneous reactions, and modify design parameters for reactor calculations.
Design chemical reactors for various industrial chemical problems.
Execute reactor startup procedures by applying appropriate conditions and trace concentration-time data with precision.
Demonstrate punctuality and attentive demeanor as an individual or in a team during the lab to improve productivity and meet deadlines.
Practice lab safety considerations while preparing reactants and collecting products for toxic or corrosive substances.
Recall standard experimental procedures and analyze and interpret results, comparing with theoretical concepts to derive valid conclusions.
Comprehend mechanisms of momentum, heat and mass transport and identify their applications for steady and transient flow systems.
Express microscopic and macroscopic mass/energy/momentum balance equations and solve them for several systems.
Analyze and solve engineering problems pertaining to transport phenomena in industrial processes.
Comprehend the characterization of differential equations and select the appropriate method for solution.
Choose and apply the methods for analytic and approximate solutions of Ordinary and Partial differential equations.
Relate the knowledge for mathematical formulation of physical problems and their solutions.
Comprehend the fundamentals of heat transfer related to steady state conduction, convection, and radiation.
Use the knowledge of heat transfer model equations to solve problems related to heat transfer systems.
Solve and analyze engineering problems pertaining to heat transfer operations.
Execute the standard startup procedure and set the requisite temperature, flows and pressures by following established protocols.
Demonstrate punctuality and attentive demeanor as an individual or in a team during the whole lab session.
Follow lab safety considerations for operating all kinds of heat exchangers and electrical heating devices.
Recall standard experimental procedures and analyze and interpret results, comparing with theoretical concepts to derive valid conclusions.
Relate the fundamentals of particulate systems to size reduction, transportation and storage of solids.
Extend the concepts of particulate behavior to illustrate the mechanism of mixing and separation of solids.
Follow equipment standard operating procedure (SOP) for particle size reduction, separation and handling.
Analyze the effect of attrition, impact and compression on particle size reduction and determine efficiency of equipment.
Grind solid particles and perform distribution analysis by use of standards (Tyler mesh) for particle size analysis.
Initiate experiment by following equipment procedure and safety SOPs.
Identify and interpret the core concepts of Newtonian mechanics to solve basic problems of applied physics.
Discuss the fundamentals of electromagnetic induction and thermometry to demonstrate the working principle of related equipment.
Realize the experiment by following instructions by the teacher.
Exhibit capability to work in team during the lab activities.
Collect data from the experiment and analyse it in the view of theoretical understanding developed during the class.
Apply fundamental numerical literacy to compute values, demonstrate numerical relationships, and construct accurate data representations.
Solve problems using fundamental mathematical and statistical concepts, demonstrate applications, and relate to real-world scenarios.
Interpret and modify data in various formats (tables, graphs, charts, equations) to produce meaningful insights.
